integrity: Derived exact conditional second moments and positive quadratic drift with matching necessity; companion symbolic and exact-rational checks are reproducibility evidence rather than independent proof or auditing. The two-component threshold is an acknowledged covered special case; prior-literature equivalence remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Identical strictly positive-definite quadratic component Hessians and common minimizer, single-index uniform-with-replacement original SAGA, finite dimension, constant positive stepsize, exact arithmetic. No unequal-Hessian, nonquadratic, nonuniform, minibatch or almost-sure endpoint claim.
title: Exact all-component-count mean-square stability of SAGA on identical positive-definite quadratics
